data.name: Back Into the Fray
data.description: You have learned to channel additional healing energy when it is most needed.  When manifesting a power of the Healing subdiscipline on a member of your collective, and the target is below 50%% of its total hit points, you can expend your psionic focus to treat that power as if affected by the Empower Power feat.
